nodes.description: Storage slot keccak256("PROXIABLE")=0xc5f16f0fcc639fa48a6947836d9850f504798523bf8c9a3a87d5876cf622bcf7 holding the logic contract address used as delegatecall target.
Constructor that stores contractLogic in the PROXIABLE slot and delegatecalls constructData to initialize the implementation.
Payable fallback that loads the stored logic address and delegatecalls all incoming calldata to it, bubbling up revert or return data.
delegatecall(contractLogic, constructData) executed in the constructor with an externally supplied logic address and initialization payload.
delegatecall(gas(), contractLogic, 0x0, calldatasize(), 0, 0) executed in the fallback, forwarding arbitrary calldata to the stored implementation inside the proxy storage context.
Constructor parameter constructData: raw initialization calldata forwarded to the logic contract via delegatecall.
Constructor parameter contractLogic: address of the implementation that is stored and later delegatecalled.
Local bool 'success' in the constructor capturing the return status of the delegatecall.
Local variable 'success' in the fallback assembly capturing the return status of the delegatecall.

edges.reason: The constructor writes contractLogic into the PROXIABLE storage slot (sstore), establishing the implementation address.
The contractLogic parameter value is the data written into the implementation storage slot.
The constructor execution path performs the delegatecall to the logic contract with constructData.
contractLogic supplied by the caller is used directly as the delegatecall target address.
constructData supplied by the caller is passed as the calldata payload of the delegatecall.
The delegatecall return status is captured in the local 'success' variable checked by require.
The fallback execution path performs the delegatecall to the stored logic address.

The fallback reads the logic address from the PROXIABLE slot (sload) and delegatecalls it with user-controlled calldata inside the proxy's own storage context, allowing arbitrary external code execution and reentrant state manipulation.
The delegatecall success flag is stored in the fallback assembly local 'success' and used to decide between revert and return.

normalization_plan.reason: constructData is a parameter only used as the calldata payload of the constructor delegatecall, so it can be folded into that unsafe operation.
contractLogic is a parameter consumed as the delegatecall target address and as the value stored in the implementation slot.
The local success flag exists solely to hold the return status of the constructor delegatecall.
The local success flag exists solely to hold the return status of the fallback delegatecall.
